title: Headless Oasis (MS10, TTW 3.4): from Birch's welcome through the Ceremony and Harold's request to the sap on Harold's Heart (stage 100)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed]. MS10 is Start Game Enabled [observed]; the player walks up to Oasis, where Tree Father Birch calls out (his first greeting, BirchGreets).

Path (Birch's way, the sap): Birch's calls and the escort to the Pavilion (BirchEscort 1-3); his talk of Him and the Ceremony of Purification (MS10BirchCTCeremony01: CeremonyGo 1, objective 5); the six Treeminders take their places (CeremonyCount 6, CeremonyGo 2); the player drinks from the basin (MS10BowlScript, button 0) and the Treeminders' ceremony lines run on (CeremonyGo 3-10) until the player passes out and wakes by Harold (stage 5, objective 5 complete); Harold asks to be killed and tells his name (MS10HaroldNameReveal03: stage 10); on the way out the exit trigger starts Laurel and Birch's argument (Argue); Birch asks for his sap (MS10BirchPostCT07) and Laurel for her liniment (MS10LaurelPostCT04: stage 20, both items); the sap goes on Harold's Heart (MS10HaroldsHeartScript, button 1: stage 30); Birch thanks the player (MS10BirchEndgame01: stage 100, MS10Fin starts). Other endings: the liniment (35, Laurel's endgame), the heart destroyed (40), Harold burnt, combat (150). [observed: MS10 stage, INFO, package and object scripts on the TTW load order]

The player starts outside Oasis's gate (OasisDoorToWasteland, locked level 255, its key never given to the player: Birch's lines unlock it [observed: INFO 0x0A02A419/0x0A02A41A/0x0A02A421]), where Birch and Maple's opening packages walk them out to meet the player. Inside, the Oasis worldspace uses its parent's land, which NVForever does not yet load (#2345): the player fell through the world.
Stand-in for Birch's escort: his two escort packages reach their ends (the AI layer's), whose end scripts move BirchEscort to 2 and 3.
Stand-in for the Treeminders walking to their places: each one's ceremony package reaches its end (the AI layer's), whose end script counts CeremonyCount; at 6 the quest script sets CeremonyGo 2.

The player drinks the sap from the basin (MS10BasinMessagePreCeremony, first button: CeremonyGo 3); the Treeminders' ceremony lines follow one another (each SayToDone counts CeremonyGo), Birch's last line makes the player pass out, and the basin's script wakes the player by Harold (stage 5).
Stand-in for the walk out of Harold's chamber: the exit trigger starts Laurel and Birch's argument (their SayTo lines, Argue 1-7); Birch's line after it gets his forcegreet ready (BirchArgueGreet).
Birch's and Laurel's forcegreets (their dialogue packages) are the player's talks with them here.
Stand-in for the way down through the caves to Harold's Heart. Its message offers destroy / sap / liniment; the second button applies the sap (stage 30).
Stand-in for the walk back up to Birch; his endgame line sets 100.
